players.bio: Aidan Robert Nesbitt (born 5 February 1997) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Falkirk. He has previously played for Partick Thistle, Dundee United, Milton Keynes Dons and Greenock Morton, after progressing through the Celtic youth academy.
Alfredo Agyeman is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a winger or forward for Scottish Premiership club Falkirk.

Aodhan Patrick Doherty is a Northern Irish footballer who plays as a right winger for Scottish Premiership club Falkirk, on loan from EFL Championship club Blackburn Rovers, as a forward. He is a Northern Ireland youth international.
Ben Carl Krauhaus is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Falkirk, on loan from Premier League club Brentford.
Ben Parkinson is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for Scottish Premiership club Falkirk.
Brad Spencer (born 16 May 1996) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Falkirk.

Calvin Jay "CJ" Fodrey (born February 10, 2004) is an American soccer player who plays as a forward for Falkirk on loan from Major League Soccer club Austin FC. Career Youth Born in California, Fodrey began his career with local San Diego based clubs Albion Pros Club, San Diego Surf, and San Diego Nomads. He then joined the youth setup of Major League Soccer club LA Galaxy in 2019.

Coll Donaldson (born 9 April 1995) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Scottish Premiership club Falkirk, where he is also club captain. Donaldson grew up in North Berwick, East Lothian and attended North Berwick High School joining Livingston's youth ranks in 2011 from Tynecastle.
Connor Allan (born Jan 10, 2004) is a 21-year-old Scottish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or centre-back for Scottish Premiership club Falkirk FC.

Craig Sibbald is a 31-year-old Scottish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Falkirk F.C.. He has previously played for Falkirk and Livingston, and represented Scotland at under-16 and under-17 level.
Deniss Meļņiks is a Latvian professional footballer who plays as a defender or midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Falkirk and the Latvia national team.

Ethan James Laidlaw (born 2 January 2005) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a forward for Scottish Premiership club Falkirk. Laidlaw is a product of the Hibernian academy and began his professional career with the club. He transferred to Brentford in 2023, for whom he exclusively played B team football until beginning his senior career with Falkirk in 2026.

Ethan Ross (born 15 August 2001) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Falkirk. He has previously played for Aberdeen and had previous loan spells at Dunfermline Athletic and Raith Rovers.
Finley Frank Barbrook is an English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Scottish Premiership side Falkirk, on loan from Premier League club Ipswich Town.
Finn Yeats (born Apr 19, 2004) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a Right-Back for Falkirk FC.
Jack McMillan (born 18 December 1997) is a Scottish footballer who plays as a defender for Falkirk F.C.
Jacob Murrell (born March 28, 2004) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a forward for Scottish Premiership club Falkirk.
Joseph Charles Gardner is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for club Falkirk. Born in England, he has represented Ireland at a youth level.

John McGlynn (born 19 December 1961) is a Scottish football coach and former player who manages Scottish League One club Falkirk. He has previously managed Scottish clubs Raith Rovers, Heart of Midlothian and Livingston.
Keelan Adams (born Nov 13, 2001) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays for Falkirk F.C. in the Scottish Premiership as a Right-Back.
Leon McCann (born Mar 16, 2000) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a Left-Back for Falkirk FC.

Lewis Neilson (born 15 May 2003) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays for for Scottish Premiership club Falkirk, on loan from fellow Scottish Premiership club Heart of Midlothian F.C. primarily as a centre back or defensive midfielder. Neilson has represented Scotland at under-16 and under-17 level.
Liam Henderson (born Aug 23, 1996) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a Centre-Back for Falkirk FC.

Nicky William Hogarth (born 4 July 2001) is a Scottish footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Scottish Premiership club Falkirk. Added to games he played on loan at Stirling Albion and Cowdenbeath, he has made over 100 senior first team appearances.

Owen Thomas Eames is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Falkirk, on loan from EFL Championship club Derby County. A youth product of Derby County, Eames made his first team debut in 2026, after signing his first professional contract in 2025.
Paul McGovern is an 18-year-old professional footballer from Northern Ireland who plays as a forward or right winger for Scottish Premiership club Falkirk F.C.

Ross MacIver (born 28 February 1999) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a forward for Scottish Premiership club Falkirk. He previously played for Ross County, Motherwell and Partick Thistle, and has spent time on loan at Wick Academy, Forfar Athletic, Elgin City, Greenock Morton and Alloa Athletic.
Ryan Strain is a professional soccer player who plays as a right back for Scottish Premiership club Falkirk FC. Born in England, he plays for the Australia national team.

Scott Bain (born 22 November 1991) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Scottish Premiership club Falkirk. Due to an injury to Allan McGregor, Scotland manager Gordon Strachan called Bain into the national squad for a friendly with Qatar and a UEFA Euro 2016 qualifying match with the Republic of Ireland in June 2015.

Scott Tanser is a 31-year-old English professional footballer who plays as an attacking left-back for Scottish Premiership club Falkirk F.C.. He made his senior debut for Rochdale in April 2013, and made a total of 57 league and cup appearances for the club before he was allowed to leave for Port Vale in January 2017.

Tom Lang (born 12 June 1997) is a Scottish footballer who plays as a defender for Scottish Premiership club Falkirk. He started his career as a youth player with Birmingham City and Rangers, and has also played for Dumbarton, Stranraer, Clyde, Dunfermline Athletic and Raith Rovers.
